_comment: Code→doc registry for sdlc-docs. Mapped to this repo's REAL paths — the shipped example pointed at docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, which does not exist here, so it would have failed every PR to main for an unwritable doc. severity 'gate' fails PR→main if the mapped doc isn't updated in the same PR; 'warn' only comments.
_severityNote: Everything starts at 'warn' deliberately. A gate that is red on day one for pre-existing reasons gets bypassed, and then it protects nothing. Raise each to 'gate' once its doc is caught up — schema first. Tracked in docs/PRIORITY-ROADMAP.md Tier 2.

mappings._note: Schema is the highest-value thing to keep documented. Promote to 'gate' first.
Money paths. Stripe, Zelle and the receipt/invoice PDFs.
Auth and role gating. DEC-004 in the hub records why code and docs currently disagree.
